title: The engineer who leads and the manager who still writes code: the two shapes of the role

videos.script: Leading a team of engineers is two jobs. {{title}} One answers for how the software is built. The design, the review, the hard technical call. That is the tech lead. {{lead}} The other answers for the people building it. Who joins, how they grow, what the team promises. That is the engineering manager. {{manager}} A small team can give both to one person. A team of seven usually cannot. {{split}} On Renata's team, Diego wanted the first job. He thought it only came with the second. {{diego}} This lesson is about the two shapes. What each one owns, and the middle where they overlap. {{middle}} What each one costs the person who takes it. And why the choice can be undone. {{pendulum}} It ends with one page. Who decides what, written down before two people answer the same question differently.
